| # Object 0x1011 restore default parameters for non-volatile storage {#object-0x1011-restore-default-parameters-for-non-volatile-storage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object entry supports restoring of default parameters.

 

  Index       0x1011
  ----------- ---------------------------------------------
  Name        restore Parameters for non volatile storage
  Object      ARRAY
  Data Type   UNSIGNED 32
  Category    Optional

 

 

SubIndex Supported

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- ----------------------------
  Description     Largest subIndex supported
  Access          RO
  Value Range     0x1-0x7F
  Default Value   0x4

 

 

  SubIndex        1
  --------------- ------------------------
  Description     Restore all parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

  SubIndex        2
  --------------- ----------------------------------
  Description     Restore communication parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

  SubIndex        3
  --------------- --------------------------------
  Description     Restore application parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

  SubIndex        4
  --------------- -----------------------------------------
  Description     Restore manufacturer defined parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0
